feed.title: duguid.com.au changelog
feed.subtitle: Site changes and tagged tool releases for Ryan Duguid's open source Australian accounting tools.

entry.title: When a business calculator flags a field, the field beside it stays where it…
entry.summary: When a business calculator flags a field, the field beside it stays where it was, and the message takes its own line below that row.

entry.title: Wrapped tool and rate titles keep their underline clear of the next line, and…
entry.summary: Wrapped tool and rate titles keep their underline clear of the next line, and on phones the changelog dates wrap so each change has room. Contact and Evaluations keep the usual gap below the page header, and figures in the cash flow comparison tables line up on the right.

entry.title: Australian Accounting Skills v0.3.1 is the recommended skills release: the…
entry.summary: Australian Accounting Skills v0.3.1 is the recommended skills release: the Adopt route, the subcontract ledger page, the agent skills manifest and llms.txt move from the 63 workflows of v0.3.0 to the 65 of v0.3.1, which adds client acceptance and working holiday maker workflows. Of its 76 validation cards, 72 have confirmed results from a whole-card model run.

entry.title: Calculator results show each figure on its own row, beside the inputs on wide…
entry.summary: Calculator results show each figure on its own row, beside the inputs on wide screens. Links have a thicker underline, buttons and table headers use the body typeface and touch tablets get 44px link targets. Below about 900px wide the homepage chart spans the page.

entry.title: On eight pages, 18 wide tables show every column again on screens about 1065px…
entry.summary: On eight pages, 18 wide tables show every column again on screens about 1065px wide or wider; since the reading measure narrowed on 26 September they had scrolled sideways even on wide screens. The Ozzit page lists all 138 named formulas with their released signatures, by module. The cash flow chart is re-exported in Public Sans, and the homepage Coal LSL inputs line up on phones.

entry.title: The Evidence page lists nine more merged upstream pull requests in six entries…
entry.summary: The Evidence page lists nine more merged upstream pull requests in six entries: two for PyXero, three for Odoo Community Association modules, and one each for ERPNext, ERPNext Australian Localisation, LedgerSMB and requests-cache. Merge states were read on 28 September 2026.

entry.title: Tool pages name the releases published by 27 September 2026 with the date…
entry.summary: Tool pages name the releases published by 27 September 2026 with the date checked, and the Payday Super quick trial moves to checker 0.1.8 with the same result. Calculators show negative amounts with a minus sign, round the required hourly rate up to the next cent and fit the 13-week forecast inputs on a phone. Every sitemap date now matches its page, and the changelog dates are row headers.

entry.title: Copy edit across the site: no serial comma, 'fictional' in place of…
entry.summary: Copy edit across the site: no serial comma, 'fictional' in place of 'fabricated', NSW in place of New South Wales, Evidence in the first person, minus signs for negative amounts and plainer sentences on Home, About, Evaluations, Privacy and Payday Super.

entry.title: Each of the 100 accounting questions is now a heading, and 28 answers open with…
entry.summary: Each of the 100 accounting questions is now a heading, and 28 answers open with a figure checked on 24 September 2026 at the ATO, Revenue NSW or Coal LSL. Question 10 now covers the 1 July 2026 changes, question 99 covers the Coal LSL levy, and each topic page publishes FAQ structured data.

entry.title: The cash flow chart on the homepage and the cash flow example was re-exported…
entry.summary: The cash flow chart on the homepage and the cash flow example was re-exported from the workbook with larger text, plus a narrower version for phones, so its axis labels and callouts are readable at the size the page shows them. The figures are unchanged.

entry.summary: Copy edit on Home, About, Tools and Evaluations: repeated disclaimers removed, homepage headings made parallel without full stops, and negative amounts and percentages written one way.

entry.title: The car limit page now explains which GST credits reduce the cost. Division 7A…
entry.summary: The car limit page now explains which GST credits reduce the cost. Division 7A figures are qualified for companies with a 30 June year end, with guidance for substituted accounting periods. Workpaper Review Gate describes its released output safeguard. The machine index, tool source dates, financial year labels and Newcastle spelling were corrected, and generated text copies were refreshed.

entry.title: The homepage now leads with Open source tools for Australian accountants and…
entry.summary: The homepage now leads with Open source tools for Australian accountants and gives clearer starting points for accounting tasks. Mobile links gained larger touch targets and layouts support enlarged text. Pure dark mode remains, with brighter homepage text, a smaller headline, sentence-case labels and simpler dividers. Unnecessary hyphens were removed across the site, stylesheet URLs were refreshed, and all five messaging preview cards were updated.

entry.title: Actions from the 20 September GEO audit: Evaluations joined the primary…
entry.summary: Actions from the 20 September GEO audit: Evaluations joined the primary navigation; the Privacy page states which AI crawlers may fetch and cite and which training crawlers are disallowed; llm-tax-guardrails is labelled an external GitHub guide, not a site tool, on the refusals page and in the machine-readable index; the index review date moved to 20 September and lists the Atom feed, which the homepage now advertises.

entry.title: The 100 accounting questions moved to ten topic pages and the nine business…
entry.summary: The 100 accounting questions moved to ten topic pages and the nine business calculators to one page each, with the old addresses kept as indexes. Three rates tables added: the maximum super contribution base, the car limit for depreciation, and the FBT rate and gross-up rates. The homepage scope strip and the Tools category links were removed, six page titles lost the site-name suffix, breadcrumbs reached every page, secondary text and form controls grew on small screens, and an Atom feed of this changelog was added.

entry.title: Actions from the 19 September site audits: the Coal LSL calculator now takes a…
entry.summary: Actions from the 19 September site audits: the Coal LSL calculator now takes a reporting month on every branch, refuses months before July 2023 and exports the exact wage basis and period in its CSV; the Payday and ATO benchmark pages carry their matching-quality and missing-bucket warnings beside the download steps; installation routes are labelled released, pinned or development; the evaluation email copy, franking introduction, cents-per-kilometre and WIP scope notes, privacy wording, machine index super summary, README tool count and changelog caption were corrected; Ozzit joined the evaluation chooser.
